note: Adapted from the species description no. 275 in Chhotani (1997), Fauna of India: Isoptera. The original is in English; only the major worker is recorded and the nymph is lacking. Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers, distribution records and descriptions of wing microsculpture are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule oval, slightly longer than wide, sides slightly convex and widest at middle; antennae 15-segmented; labrum ligulate, reaching the distal third of the mandibles, apex broad and pointed, not spear-shaped, longer than wide; mandibles thin and weak, apex slightly incurved, slightly longer than half the head length, left mandible with a minute vestigial tooth on the distal third; pronotum saddle-shaped. Alate with antennae 17–18-segmented, segment 4 shortest.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow to light reddish brown; antennae and labrum white to light yellowish brown; body cream-white to light yellowish brown. Head and body rather densely pilose. Body length 3.20–5.0 mm. Head capsule oval, slightly longer than wide (0.85–1.03 mm to base of mandibles, maximum width 0.78–0.95 mm); sides slightly convex, widest at middle. Antennae 15-segmented; segments 2 to 5 variable in size. Labrum ligulate, reaching distal third of mandibles; apex broad and pointed, not spear-shaped; longer than wide (0.28–0.35 mm long, 0.25–0.30 mm wide). Mandibles thin and weak, apex slightly incurved (0.58–0.65 mm long), slightly longer than half the head length (mandible length to head length ratio 0.62–0.67). Left mandible with a minute vestigial tooth on the distal third; right mandible toothless. Postmentum convex, arched; sides convex (0.43–0.53 mm long, 0.33–0.45 mm wide). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin distinctly concave, posterior margin slightly concave (0.35–0.48 mm long, 0.55–0.70 mm wide).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic; the original records only the major worker. Head light yellowish brown; body whitish. Head and body rather densely pilose. Body length 4.0–5.0 mm. Head subquadrate (0.98–1.20 mm to base of mandibles, maximum width 1.08–1.15 mm). Antennae 15–16-segmented. Postclypeus convex, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.20–0.28 mm long, 0.45–0.55 mm wide); anterior margin distinctly concave, posterior margin nearly straight.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule chestnut brown; antennae, labrum and postclypeus light yellowish brown; abdomen paler than head capsule. Head and body moderately densely pilose. Body length with wings 22.0–23.75 mm, without wings 10.0–11.5 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long (1.25–1.45 mm to base of mandibles, maximum width including compound eyes 1.70–1.93 mm). Fontanelle transparent, subcircular, a small spot (0.08 mm in diameter). Compound eyes large, subcircular, protruding (maximum diameter 0.40–0.50 mm, minimum diameter 0.35–0.45 mm). Ocellus large, oval (long diameter 0.20–0.26 mm, short diameter 0.17–0.20 mm); separated from compound eye by half its short diameter (eye–ocellus distance 0.07–0.10 mm). Antennae 17–18-segmented; in 17-segmented specimens segment 2 equal to segment 3, in 18-segmented specimens segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 combined; segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus convex, slightly less than half as long as wide. Pronotum subhemispherical (0.90–1.05 mm long, 1.48–1.70 mm wide); anterior margin slightly incurved, middle slightly raised and with a weak notch; posterior margin shallowly concave. Wings transparent, yellow, with a few hairs on the distal third of the membrane; forewing 15.0–17.0 mm long, hindwing 14.0–16.0 mm long.
